svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 820 mm of 20 mm bright steel bar; chamfer both ends 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill a 5 mm cross hole 10 mm from each end for the linch pins,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: both holes in the same plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide it through both bracket holes so 410 mm stands each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the centre line; weld it to both brackets, all round, both faces.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each end then takes, in order: a spacer collar 26 mm outside,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm bore, 37.5 mm long; the wheel hub (60 mm long);

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: a 20 mm washer 3 mm thick; the linch pin.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the wheels spin freely with 0.5 to 1 mm end float.
